summary_points: Initialing required on cover sheet only; all other title block info on all pages
Revisions identified in the body of the Specification
Notice of Alternate Billing Cycle available from Teyma USA & Abener Engineering and Construction Services General Partnership
Confidentiality terms apply to information and know-how
Instrument Specification for Differencial Pressure Level Transmitters in TES Area
All materials must meet NEC, IEEE, UL standards
Vendor must provide detailed delivery schedule and spare parts list
Equipment must be inspected before shipment by Abener Teyma personnel
Alternate quotations are welcome with prices and delivery times
Two differential pressure level transmitters (LIT-1/2/3/4/5/6-251-01B and LIT-1/2/3/4/5/6-252-01A) are specified for Cold Salt Tank X-MT-251 - Backup and Hot Salt Tank X-MT-253.

Both transmitters have a design pressure of atm, with the cold salt tank transmitter having an upper fluid phase of nitrogen and the hot salt tank transmitter having an upper fluid phase of molten salt.
The transmitters are equipped with a single-variable differential pressure sensor and a traditional flange body made of 316SS material.
Calibration ranges for both transmitters are from 0-750 " WC to 4-20 mA DC, with the cold salt tank transmitter having an additional range up to 775 " WC.
The output range is 4-20mA + HART, and power supply is provided by a 24VDC source.
Enclosures are made of painted aluminum and rated for NEMA 4 / NEMA 4X class with Class I, Division II, Group D electrical classification.
